description: Labeled routing cases for the Scout Intent eval harness (P2.3). Each case is a representative natural-language intake prompt and the workflow the Scout MUST route it to. The harness runs the REAL, VENDORED Meterless Scout engine (vendor/meterless/scout-intent/impl, via src/adapters/meterless/scout.ts) over each case (no mocked routing) and scores exact-workflow accuracy + band behavior. INVARIANT: routing is real, deterministic example+description scoring over data/scout-registry.json — never hardcoded to the expected answer. expectBand is the deterministic band the REAL engine's scoring curve produces (HIGH>=0.8 / MED>=0.55 / LOW>=0.4 / NONE below) — recalibrated when the product swapped onto the real engine; mutate a prompt and both workflow and band change, so the harness is falsifiable.

cases.prompt: how much should we reserve on this claim
what liability do we set aside for CLM-4471
how much do we pay out on the fire loss
is this damage covered under the policy
does the policy exclusion apply to this peril
check coverage for the water claim
the sources conflict on timing and the record is ambiguous
the CAT window close date is missing so this is unclear
there is a dispute over conflicting treaty facts
